contract: offline artifact / fault-injection corpus (fix-dv-19.02) for crypto-payments — sibling of fix-dv-19.01.json (stripe-billing). Each case injects a fault, runs a state/output ORACLE (not a protocol/provider stub judging itself), and records exit/trace/environment. DV-19: the counterexample FAILS pre-fix and PASSES after the fix, verified by STATE and OUTPUTS, tied to a release.
release_tie: the fix ships in a tagged release; a counterexample that passes pre-fix is not a fix

environment.note: provider/protocol stubs (Heleket) are inputs, never the oracle

cases.fault: credit waterfall mixes Money (USD minor) and an Asset amount (crypto decimals) with ??
cases.prefix_expect: FAIL (a 10.5 TON tokenAmount credited as 10.5 USD-minor via ??)
cases.postfix_expect: PASS (Asset converts through a dated quote to USD minor before compare)

cases.fault: a buffered payment with NO excess policy configured
cases.prefix_expect: FAIL (a default 'credit' invented, the business price baked in)
cases.postfix_expect: PASS (missing policy BLOCKS invoice creation, invents no fee)

cases.fault: an Asset→Money conversion with an unknown/undated FX source
cases.prefix_expect: FAIL (a guessed rate produces a plausible-but-wrong USD credit)
cases.postfix_expect: PASS (unknown FX source BLOCKS the conversion)
